about: Clef on Workers AI, from developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-flash (request example and output schema, Oct 2026).
POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<account id>/ai/run/@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash (or .../clef for a hard case) with Authorization: Bearer <token>.
The REST API wraps the model's answer as { result, success, errors, messages }. Clef-omni (@cf/cloudflare/clef-omni) takes the same body plus audio and videos, and is not used.
